runs.question: Which OMB memo currently governs how federal agencies acquire AI, and what happened to the earlier acquisition memo?

answer.text:
OMB Memorandum M-25-22, "Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government," governs this area. It is dated April 3, 2025. It rescinds and replaces OMB Memorandum M-24-18, Advancing the Responsible Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government.

M-24-18 was the earlier acquisition memo. It was dated September 24, 2024, though the document title lists October 2024. Under M-25-22, M-24-18 is no longer the governing guidance, so the requirements in M-24-18 should not be treated as current.

M-25-22 states that it is consistent with the Advancing American AI Act, Executive Order 14179, and OMB Memorandum M-25-21. It also directs agencies to pay careful attention to vendor sourcing, data portability, and long-term interoperability to avoid significant and costly dependencies on a single vendor.

The passages do not say which specific M-24-18 requirements were kept, changed, or dropped in M-25-22. They also do not cover M-25-22's other provisions beyond its overview.
